_comment: Native-layer strings (D43): iOS permission purposes (InfoPlist.strings via expo.locales) and the widget gallery names (iOS Localizable.strings keyed by the English literals the generated Swift carries; Android values-b+<lang>/strings.xml keyed by the plugin's derived resource names). The app name stays the brand Athan in every language. The owner verifies every string in the confidence build (D42).
